desc.zh: 保留同层的每条来路，重建全部最短变换。
desc.en: Keep every same-layer parent and reconstruct all shortest transformations.

complexity: O(26NL² + M) time / O(NL + E + M) space including output

concepts.name: Multiple shortest parents
concepts.description: Keep every edge that increases distance by one.

concepts.name: Path reconstruction
concepts.description: Follow decreasing distances to enumerate all answers.
